game.name: Saints Row 2 (Germany)
game.desc: Help the 3rd Streets take back their city in this explosive sequal to the 2006 hit. Saints Row 2 features unparalleled character creation and customization; a massive open world to explore by land, air or sea; and online co-op play that enables you and a friend play through the entire story of Saints Row 2.
game.genre: Action / Adventure, Action, Adventure / RealTime 3D, Adventure
